description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.
 
 What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.
 
 
 Job Summary

 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Full Stack Solution Engineer to design, develop, and modernize scalable software solutions within McKesson Medical Surgical's Data & Advanced Analytics (DAAA) organization.

 The role will work across the full application stack, with a strong focus on Python, React, APIs, cloud-native development, and modern software engineering practices . The engineer will also play an important role in the upcoming migration and modernization of DAAA applications onto Google Cloud Platform (GCP) .

 We are increasingly adopting AI-assisted and agentic software development practices , so we are particularly interested in engineers with experience using AI coding assistants, coding agents, or agentic development workflows to accelerate software delivery while maintaining appropriate engineering standards and human oversight. 
 

 Job Responsibilities

 Lead the end-to-end design, development, testing, deployment, and support of full-stack applications.
 Develop modern web applications using technologies such as React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and REST APIs .
 Design and implement secure, scalable back-end services, APIs, and microservices using modern architectural patterns.
 Design intuitive, responsive, and accessible user interfaces using contemporary front-end frameworks.
 Play an active role in the migration and modernization of existing applications to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , including application assessment, refactoring, target architecture, testing, cutover, and post-migration support.
 Identify opportunities to modernize legacy or low-code solutions as scalable web applications or using appropriate GCP-native services . 
 Apply AI-assisted and agentic coding practices across the software development lifecycle, using coding agents and AI development tools to assist with areas such as requirements analysis, implementation, testing, code review, documentation, and application modernization.
 Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, data scientists, QA, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
 Design and manage relational and/or NoSQL data solutions, ensuring appropriate performance, security, reliability, and scalability.
 Participate in code and architecture reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards, security requirements, and development best practices.
 Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines , testing, code-quality controls, and deployment processes.
 Troubleshoot complex application and production issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions.
 Contribute to the continuous improvement of DAAA development standards, reusable components, development tooling, and engineering practices.
 Evaluate emerging technologies, particularly across cloud, AI, automation, and agentic software engineering , and assess their applicability to DAAA solutions.
 
 Job Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 4+ years of professional software engineering experience , with significant experience designing and delivering production full-stack applications.
 Strong hands-on experience with Python and modern Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django .
 Strong experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript , HTML, and CSS.
 Strong understanding of API design, including RESTful APIs , authentication/authorization, integration patterns, and microservices.
 Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL , with familiarity with modern data and analytics platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or Google BigQuery .
 Practical experience developing or deploying applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , or significant experience with another major cloud platform combined with the ability to transition to GCP.
 Experience with cloud and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes , and familiarity with cloud-native application architectures.
 Experience with Git/GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing, code-quality tooling, DevSecOps practices, and Agile delivery .
 Experience with AI-assisted software development and agentic coding workflows , such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Gemini, or comparable coding agents and AI development tools.
 Ability to use AI development tools responsibly while maintaining human review, code quality, security, testing, and engineering governance .
 Experience with application modernization or cloud migration initiatives is highly desirable.
 Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, data, and business teams.
 Ability to operate independently while contributing effectively within a distributed engineering team.
 

 Nice to Have

 Experience migrating applications from Azure to GCP .
 Experience with GCP services and technologies such as Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, IAM, Vertex AI, Gemini, or Looker .
 Experience modernizing Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, or other low-code/automation solutions into cloud-native or full-stack applications. 
 Experience with AI agents, MCP, agent orchestration, tool calling, coding-agent workflows, or multi-agent development patterns .
 Experience with observability, automated testing, security scanning, and production application support.
 
 We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please  click here. 
 
 Our Base Pay Range for this position 
 
$110,300 - $183,800 
 
 McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.
 
McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates.
 
 McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: careers.mckesson.com .
